entities.summary: Morgan Cox is an American professional football long snapper for the Tennessee Titans of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Tennessee Volunteers and was signed by the Baltimore Ravens as an undrafted free agent in 2010. Cox spent 11 seasons with the Ravens from 2010 to 2020, winning Super Bowl XLVII with the team during the 2012 season.
